review_kind: AI technical review (Claude Opus 5.5), no native-speaker signoff
note: Instruction 316, maintainer decision 2026-09-25, third to fifth passes 2026-09-26, sixth pass 2026-09-27: runtime (GUI) translation debt written and technically reviewed by AI against the English source and its code context. No human and no native speaker has read these rows.

records.key: A CSV or Excel table with a SMILES column and a compound name, and a well column (with a plate column when plates differ) or names matching the Treatment column. Hits are then drawn with their structures, clustered by similarity and exported as SAR tables. Clustering needs RDKit (pip install rdkit).
records.source: A CSV or Excel table with a SMILES column and a compound name, and a well column (with a plate column when plates differ) or names matching the Treatment column. Hits are then drawn with their structures, clustered by similarity and exported as SAR tables. Clustering needs RDKit (pip install rdkit).
records.translation: 一个 CSV 或 Excel 表，包含 SMILES 列和化合物名称，以及孔列（板不同时还需板列）或与 Treatment 列匹配的名称。随后会绘制候选命中的结构，按相似度聚类并导出为 SAR 表。聚类需要 RDKit，安装命令为 pip install rdkit 。

records.key: Analyse replicates as pairs, so replicate-to-replicate variation cancels. Default off.
records.source: Analyse replicates as pairs, so replicate-to-replicate variation cancels. Default off.
records.translation: 将重复成对分析，使重复之间的变异相互抵消。默认关闭。

records.key: Assemble a submission package for the Image Data Resource or the BioImage Archive: MIHCSME and REMBI metadata taken from the settings spaCR saved, the images and a plate map, plus a short form for what spaCR cannot know, with the IDR study and library files, a BioStudies study and file list, and MD5 checksums. Nothing is uploaded and the run folder is not written to. Default not made.
records.source: Assemble a submission package for the Image Data Resource or the BioImage Archive: MIHCSME and REMBI metadata taken from the settings spaCR saved, the images and a plate map, plus a short form for what spaCR cannot know, with the IDR study and library files, a BioStudies study and file list, and MD5 checksums. Nothing is uploaded and the run folder is not written to. Default not made.
records.translation: 为 Image Data Resource 或 BioImage Archive 组装提交包：取自 spaCR 所保存设置的 MIHCSME 和 REMBI 元数据、图像和板布局图，外加一份填写 spaCR 无法得知内容的简短表单，以及 IDR 研究和文库文件、BioStudies 研究和文件列表，以及 MD5 校验和。不会上传任何内容，也不会写入运行文件夹。默认不生成。

records.key: Browse a catalogue of community plugins and assay recipes. A plugin is installed into its own folder with the libraries it needs, so it never replaces a package spaCR uses; a recipe is saved as a settings file you can load into its module.
records.source: Browse a catalogue of community plugins and assay recipes. A plugin is installed into its own folder with the libraries it needs, so it never replaces a package spaCR uses; a recipe is saved as a settings file you can load into its module.
records.translation: 浏览社区插件和实验配方目录。插件会连同所需的库安装到各自的文件夹中，因此绝不会替换 spaCR 使用的包；配方保存为可载入对应模块的设置文件。

records.key: CellProfiler 4.2, run headless on a lab's own .cppipe pipeline from Measure: spaCR hands it each field's channels and masks as TIFFs and brings its per-object measurements back into measurements.db keyed by spaCR's object ids. It needs a Python 3.8 or 3.9 on this computer to build its environment.
records.source: CellProfiler 4.2, run headless on a lab's own .cppipe pipeline from Measure: spaCR hands it each field's channels and masks as TIFFs and brings its per-object measurements back into measurements.db keyed by spaCR's object ids. It needs a Python 3.8 or 3.9 on this computer to build its environment.
records.translation: CellProfiler 4.2，在 Measure 中以无界面方式运行实验室自己的 .cppipe 流程：spaCR 将每个视野的通道和掩膜以 TIFFs 交给它，并将其逐对象测量结果按 spaCR 的对象 ID 取回到 measurements.db。它需要本机上有 Python 3.8 或 3.9 来构建其环境。

records.key: CellProfiler 4.2.8.1 and cellprofiler-core are BSD-3-Clause (Broad Institute). They read images through Bio-Formats (GPL-2.0, shipped inside prokaryote) on a Java 11 development kit that the install fetches from Eclipse Adoptium (GPL-2.0 with the Classpath Exception) into the backend's own folder. CellProfiler's desktop interface (wxPython) and its MySQL export are not installed: pipelines run headless. spaCR ships none of it.
records.source: CellProfiler 4.2.8.1 and cellprofiler-core are BSD-3-Clause (Broad Institute). They read images through Bio-Formats (GPL-2.0, shipped inside prokaryote) on a Java 11 development kit that the install fetches from Eclipse Adoptium (GPL-2.0 with the Classpath Exception) into the backend's own folder. CellProfiler's desktop interface (wxPython) and its MySQL export are not installed: pipelines run headless. spaCR ships none of it.
records.translation: CellProfiler 4.2.8.1 和 cellprofiler-core 采用 BSD-3-Clause 许可（Broad Institute）。它们通过 Bio-Formats（GPL-2.0，随 prokaryote 提供）读取图像，运行于安装时从 Eclipse Adoptium（GPL-2.0 附 Classpath Exception）下载到后端自己文件夹的 Java 11 开发工具包上。CellProfiler 的桌面界面（wxPython）及其 MySQL 导出不会安装：流程以无界面方式运行。spaCR 不附带其中任何内容。

records.key: Cheapest design: {replicates} replicates, {wells} wells per condition, {fields} fields per well; power {power:.2f}, {simulated:.2f} in 500 simulated experiments.
records.source: Cheapest design: {replicates} replicates, {wells} wells per condition, {fields} fields per well; power {power:.2f}, {simulated:.2f} in 500 simulated experiments.
records.translation: 最经济的设计：{replicates} 个重复，每个条件 {wells} 个孔，每孔 {fields} 个视野；统计功效 {power:.2f}，500 次模拟实验中为 {simulated:.2f}。

records.key: Column naming each well, unique across plates. Default prc.
records.source: Column naming each well, unique across plates. Default prc.
records.translation: 为每个孔命名的列，在所有板中唯一。默认值 prc。

records.key: Column naming the biological replicate, such as plateID when each plate is one; leave empty when the pilot has one replicate and the replicate variance cannot be estimated. Default empty.
records.source: Column naming the biological replicate, such as plateID when each plate is one; leave empty when the pilot has one replicate and the replicate variance cannot be estimated. Default empty.
records.translation: 为生物学重复命名的列，例如每块板即为一个重复时的 plateID；当预实验只有一个重复、无法估计重复方差时请留空。默认值为空。

records.key: Column naming the field within its well. Default fieldID.
records.source: Column naming the field within its well. Default fieldID.
records.translation: 指明视野在其孔中编号的列。默认值 fieldID。

records.key: Could not search for similar crops: {msg}
records.source: Could not search for similar crops: {msg}
records.translation: 无法搜索相似的裁剪图：{msg}

records.key: Deposit this run on Zenodo so the analysis gets a citable DOI: the archive package, settings, run journal, report, result tables and, if asked, the masks, with the archive form as its metadata. Uses your own Zenodo token, kept in the system keyring or a private file. The sandbox, for trying it out, is on until you turn it off; a draft is left to publish on Zenodo unless you publish here. Default not deposited.
records.source: Deposit this run on Zenodo so the analysis gets a citable DOI: the archive package, settings, run journal, report, result tables and, if asked, the masks, with the archive form as its metadata. Uses your own Zenodo token, kept in the system keyring or a private file. The sandbox, for trying it out, is on until you turn it off; a draft is left to publish on Zenodo unless you publish here. Default not deposited.
records.translation: 将本次运行存档到 Zenodo，使分析获得可引用的 DOI：包括归档包、设置、运行日志、报告、结果表，以及（如需要）掩膜，并以归档表单作为元数据。使用您自己的 Zenodo 令牌，保存在系统密钥环或私有文件中。用于试用的沙盒在您关闭之前一直开启；除非在此处发布，否则会在 Zenodo 上留下待发布的草稿。默认不存档。

records.key: Deposited {count} files as a Zenodo draft at {url}; its reserved DOI is {doi}. Publish it there.
records.source: Deposited {count} files as a Zenodo draft at {url}; its reserved DOI is {doi}. Publish it there.
records.translation: 已将 {count} 个文件作为 Zenodo 草稿存档于 {url}；其预留 DOI 为 {doi}。请在那里发布。

records.key: Difference between the two condition means to detect, in the measurement's units. Default 0.
records.source: Difference between the two condition means to detect, in the measurement's units. Default 0.
records.translation: 要检测的两种条件均值之差，以测量值的单位表示。默认值 0。

records.key: Load a compound table to draw the hits' structures.
records.source: Load a compound table to draw the hits' structures.
records.translation: 载入化合物表以绘制候选命中的结构。

records.key: Mean {mean:.4g}; variance between replicates {rep}, wells {well:.4g}, fields {field:.4g}, cells {cell:.4g}; {cells:.0f} cells per field.
records.source: Mean {mean:.4g}; variance between replicates {rep}, wells {well:.4g}, fields {field:.4g}, cells {cell:.4g}; {cells:.0f} cells per field.
records.translation: 均值 {mean:.4g}；方差：重复间 {rep}，孔间 {well:.4g}，视野间 {field:.4g}，细胞间 {cell:.4g}；每个视野 {cells:.0f} 个细胞。

records.key: Open an experiment source before searching it.
records.source: Open an experiment source before searching it.
records.translation: 请先打开实验来源，再进行搜索。

records.key: Per-cell column the experiment will compare. Default empty.
records.source: Per-cell column the experiment will compare. Default empty.
records.translation: 实验将比较的逐细胞列。默认值为空。

records.key: Per-cell measurements from a pilot plate: a CSV, Parquet, Excel or spaCR measurement database. Default empty.
records.source: Per-cell measurements from a pilot plate: a CSV, Parquet, Excel or spaCR measurement database. Default empty.
records.translation: 来自预实验板的逐细胞测量：CSV、Parquet、Excel 文件或 spaCR 测量数据库。默认值为空。

records.key: Probability of a significant result the design must reach. Default 0.8.
records.source: Probability of a significant result the design must reach. Default 0.8.
records.translation: 设计必须达到的显著结果概率。默认值 0.8。

records.key: Published results: Stirling et al., 'CellProfiler 4: improvements in speed, utility and usability', BMC Bioinformatics 2021 (doi:10.1186/s12859-021-04344-9). It measures what the pipeline says; spaCR scores nothing here.
records.source: Published results: Stirling et al., 'CellProfiler 4: improvements in speed, utility and usability', BMC Bioinformatics 2021 (doi:10.1186/s12859-021-04344-9). It measures what the pipeline says; spaCR scores nothing here.
records.translation: 已发表结果：Stirling et al., 'CellProfiler 4: improvements in speed, utility and usability', BMC Bioinformatics 2021 (doi:10.1186/s12859-021-04344-9)。它测量流程规定的内容；spaCR 在此不做任何评分。

records.key: Published {count} files on Zenodo: DOI {doi}, {url}
records.source: Published {count} files on Zenodo: DOI {doi}, {url}
records.translation: 已在 Zenodo 上发布 {count} 个文件：DOI {doi}，{url}

records.key: Reading the measurements to compare crops by…
records.source: Reading the measurements to compare crops by…
records.translation: 正在读取用于比较裁剪图的测量值…

records.key: Table to read when the pilot is a database. Default cell.
records.source: Table to read when the pilot is a database. Default cell.
records.translation: 预实验为数据库时要读取的表。默认值 cell。

records.key: Tables (*.csv *.tsv *.txt *.xlsx *.xls *.parquet)
records.source: Tables (*.csv *.tsv *.txt *.xlsx *.xls *.parquet)
records.translation: 表格文件 (*.csv *.tsv *.txt *.xlsx *.xls *.parquet)

records.key: The Tanimoto similarity of Morgan fingerprints (radius 2) a hit needs to a cluster's centre to join it; other compounds join the cluster of their most similar hit at the same similarity. Default 0.6.
records.source: The Tanimoto similarity of Morgan fingerprints (radius 2) a hit needs to a cluster's centre to join it; other compounds join the cluster of their most similar hit at the same similarity. Default 0.6.
records.translation: 候选命中加入某个聚类所需的与聚类中心之间的 Morgan 指纹（半径 2）Tanimoto 相似度；其他化合物以相同相似度加入与其最相似的候选命中所在的聚类。默认值 0.6。

records.key: Two-sided significance level of the t-test on replicate means. Default 0.05.
records.source: Two-sided significance level of the t-test on replicate means. Default 0.05.
records.translation: 对重复均值进行 t 检验的双侧显著性水平。默认值 0.05。

records.key: Use the Zenodo sandbox (a test deposit, no real DOI)
records.source: Use the Zenodo sandbox (a test deposit, no real DOI)
records.translation: 使用 Zenodo 沙盒（测试存档，不生成真实 DOI）

records.key: When an image figure or montage is saved, warn if panels meant for comparison use different display ranges, if pixels are saturated or clipped, if a panel is repeated, or if a lossy format was chosen. Also writes the source files, display settings, processing steps and spaCR version into the file's metadata and a .provenance.json file beside it. Default off.
records.source: When an image figure or montage is saved, warn if panels meant for comparison use different display ranges, if pixels are saturated or clipped, if a panel is repeated, or if a lossy format was chosen. Also writes the source files, display settings, processing steps and spaCR version into the file's metadata and a .provenance.json file beside it. Default off.
records.translation: 保存图像图或拼图时，若用于比较的面板使用了不同的显示范围、像素饱和或被截断、面板重复，或选择了有损格式，则发出警告。还会将源文件、显示设置、处理步骤和 spaCR 版本写入文件元数据，以及旁边的 .provenance.json 文件。默认关闭。

records.key: Where the catalogue is: a catalogue.json file, the folder holding one, or an http(s) address. It is remembered for next time. Default the SPACR_PLUGIN_CATALOGUE variable, else empty.
records.source: Where the catalogue is: a catalogue.json file, the folder holding one, or an http(s) address. It is remembered for next time. Default the SPACR_PLUGIN_CATALOGUE variable, else empty.
records.translation: 目录所在位置：catalogue.json 文件、包含该文件的文件夹，或 http(s) 地址。下次会记住。默认使用 SPACR_PLUGIN_CATALOGUE 变量，否则为空。

records.key: Write this run as a Snakemake or Nextflow workflow that runs the same module with the same settings once per plate, with spacr-run on this machine, a cluster, or the spaCR container image.
records.source: Write this run as a Snakemake or Nextflow workflow that runs the same module with the same settings once per plate, with spacr-run on this machine, a cluster, or the spaCR container image.
records.translation: 将本次运行写成 Snakemake 或 Nextflow 工作流，对每块板以相同设置运行同一模块一次，可通过 spacr-run 在本机、集群或 spaCR 容器镜像中运行。

records.key: Wrote {path}, but it does not pass: {problems}
records.source: Wrote {path}, but it does not pass: {problems}
records.translation: 已写入 {path}，但未通过检查：{problems}

records.key: Wrote {path}. It passes the IDR, BioStudies and MIHCSME checks; nothing was uploaded.
records.source: Wrote {path}. It passes the IDR, BioStudies and MIHCSME checks; nothing was uploaded.
records.translation: 已写入 {path}。它通过了 IDR、BioStudies 和 MIHCSME 检查；未上传任何内容。

records.key: {name} and the {n} crops most like it, most similar first
records.source: {name} and the {n} crops most like it, most similar first
records.translation: {name} 以及与其最相似的 {n} 个裁剪图，按相似度从高到低排列

retired_records.key: Show the 100 crops whose measurements are most like the selected crop, the one with the ring, most similar first, so a rare class found once can be labelled many times. The first search on a source reads its measurements and takes a few seconds; later ones are instant. Back to all crops by opening the source again. Default not run.
retired_records.source: Show the 100 crops whose measurements are most like the selected crop, the one with the ring, most similar first, so a rare class found once can be labelled many times. The first search on a source reads its measurements and takes a few seconds; later ones are instant. Back to all crops by opening the source again. Default not run.
retired_records.translation: 显示测量值与所选裁剪图（带圆环的那个）最相似的 100 个裁剪图，按相似度从高到低排列，这样只发现一次的罕见类别也能被多次标注。对一个来源的首次搜索需读取其测量值，耗时几秒；之后的搜索即时完成。重新打开来源即可回到全部裁剪图。默认不运行。
